name: door-hardware-verify
description: DOOR-HARDWARE: butt hinges on every jamb (knuckle tangent to the SWING-side face, so a hinge is only visible from the side its door opens into, and only up close — the hinge shot is therefore taken inside the MAIN BEDROOM at its own door: bedroom 2's hinge jamb is permanently occluded by the 3-door wardrobe the default layout parks over that doorway), the returned lever with its privacy-turn cylinder, the main door's digital lock + kick plate, and the floor stopper at the 85°-open free edge. Walk poses at Realistic, 13:00, lights on, then the bedroom2 room editor (walk BEFORE the editor — entering walk from the editor leaves that room's walls stale-faded and culls wall-overlay detail). Probes the scene for the named hardware meshes (door-hinge / door-lever / door-rose / door-escutcheon / door-cylinder / door-lock / door-kickplate / door-stopper). Run with SHOT_GPU=1. Pair with the same scenario at SHOT_URL='http://localhost:5200/?ff=doorHardware:off' for the before frames.

steps.name: setup
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.dismissChecklist?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); s.setTimeMode?.('manual'); s.setLightsMode?.('on'); s.setQualityTier?.('realistic'); s.setDeviceClass?.('capable'); s.hideLoading?.(); s.setFeatureFlag?.('interactiveDegrade', false) })()

steps.name: pin-device-class
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store; s.getState().setDeviceClass('capable'); s.setState({ setDeviceClass: () => {} }) })()

steps.name: probe-hardware
steps.eval: (() => { const by = {}; window.__three.scene.traverse(o => { if (!o.isMesh || !o.name || o.name.indexOf('door-') !== 0) return; by[o.name] = (by[o.name] || 0) + 1 }); const total = Object.values(by).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0); console.log('[probe] door-hardware', JSON.stringify({ flag: window.__store.getState().featureFlags.doorHardware, total, by })) })()

steps.name: pose-corridor
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(8.9, 4.3); l.setYaw(1.5708); l.setPitch(-0.02) })()

steps.name: pose-bedroom2-door
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(5.5, 4.7); l.setYaw(0.29); l.setPitch(-0.5) })()

steps.name: pose-hinge-jamb
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(2.55, 4.35); l.setYaw(-1.2); l.setPitch(-0.516) })()

steps.name: open-bedroom2-door
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); if (!(s.doors['door-bedroom2'] && s.doors['door-bedroom2'].open)) s.toggleDoor('door-bedroom2') })()

steps.name: pose-bedroom2-stopper
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(5.05, 1.4); l.setYaw(3.1416); l.setPitch(-0.78) })()

steps.name: close-bedroom2-door
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); if (s.doors['door-bedroom2'] && s.doors['door-bedroom2'].open) s.toggleDoor('door-bedroom2') })()

steps.name: pose-main-door
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(11.0, 6.6); l.setYaw(3.1416); l.setPitch(-0.05) })()

steps.name: pose-main-door-lock
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(11.0, 7.3); l.setYaw(3.1416); l.setPitch(-0.1) })()

steps.name: probe-editor
steps.eval: (() => { const by = {}; window.__three.scene.traverse(o => { if (!o.isMesh || !o.name || o.name.indexOf('door-') !== 0) return; by[o.name] = (by[o.name] || 0) + 1 }); const total = Object.values(by).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0); console.log('[probe] editor door-hardware', JSON.stringify({ total, by })) })()
